question.worked_solution:
The recursive formula is

$$
{a}_{n+1}=7{a}_{n}-3.
$$

where ${a}_{1}=1.$

We use this formula to compute the terms ${a}_{2}$ and ${a}_{3}$ as follows:

- We first compute ${a}_{2}$ by substituting $n=1$ into the recursive formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n+1} & =7{a}_{n}-3 \\ {a}_{1+1} & =7{a}_{1}-3 \\ {a}_{2} & =7{a}_{1}-3 \\ {a}_{2} & =7(1)-3 \\ {a}_{2} & =4\end{aligned}
$$

- Then, we compute ${a}_{3}$ by substituting $n=2$ into the recursive formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n+1} & =7{a}_{n}-3 \\ {a}_{2+1} & =7{a}_{2}-3 \\ {a}_{3} & =7{a}_{2}-3 \\ {a}_{3} & =7(4)-3 \\ {a}_{3} & =25\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, ${a}_{3}=25.$
